subject.title: fix(update): dev channel update builds from an unverified checkout at the git install path

question: Should package-to-dev conversion categorically reject every existing OPENCLAW_GIT_DIR, accepting the compatibility break in exchange for never trusting pre-existing Git state?
rationale: Remote inspection cannot prove an adopted checkout is safe, but refusing all existing paths changes a previously supported setup and recovery workflow; repository automation should not choose that security-versus-compatibility boundary.

options.title: Require fresh checkouts
options.body: Approve the existing-path refusal as the secure default after moving retry ownership into the shared SQLite state store.

options.title: Preserve an adoption path
options.body: Require a separately designed, explicitly invoked migration or adoption workflow with owner-approved security guarantees and upgrade tests.

recommendation.title: Require fresh checkouts
recommendation.body: Approve the existing-path refusal as the secure default after moving retry ownership into the shared SQLite state store.
